exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: same, water, fields, cottages, houses, little,
         fifty years, shops, boats, like

Barcha iboralar 62–63-betdagi Inishmore matnlaridan olingan.

QANDAY TANLANADI:
  bo'shliq OLDIDA sifat bo'lsa → OT kerak
     fishing ...... → boats
  bo'shliq KEYINIDA ot bo'lsa → SIFAT kerak
     a ...... island → little

items.whyUz:
'a little island' = kichik orol.
63-betdagi maqolada: 'a beautiful little island'.
Gap: Inishmore is a little island.

'fifty years ago' = ellik yil oldin.
'ago' — o'tgan vaqtni bildiradi, DOIM gap oxirida.
Gap: Fifty years ago, life was difficult.

'the same AS' = ...bilan bir xil.
Maqolada: 'exactly the same as it was fifty years ago'.
DIQQAT: 'the same LIKE' XATO — 'as' bo'lishi kerak.

'fishing boats' = baliqchi qayiqlari.
Gap: There were only donkeys and fishing boats.

'stone cottages' = tosh kulbalar.
Gap: They only had small stone cottages.

'running water' = vodoprovod suvi.
Gap: They didn't have electricity or running water.

'just like this' = xuddi shundayligicha.
'like' bu yerda PREDLOG — '...kabi' ('yoqtirmoq' EMAS).
Gap: We're working hard to keep it just like this.

'modern houses' = zamonaviy uylar.
5-band bilan solishtiring: ilgari 'stone cottages', hozir 'modern houses'.
Gap: They have got new, modern houses.

'souvenir shops' = sovg'a do'konlari.
Gap: There are lots of souvenir shops now.

'green fields' = yashil dalalar.
Gap: Coneely looks across the green fields in front of his house.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the opposites of the phrases below, using the words in the list. Then, make sentences using the phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi iboralarning qarama-qarshisini ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan yozing. So'ng iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: busy, big, a lot of

'≠' belgisi QARAMA-QARSHI ma'noni bildiradi.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA GAP:
  Inishmore is a little island.

DIQQAT — 'FEW' va 'A LOT OF':
  few tourists = kam sayyoh (deyarli yo'q)
  a lot of tourists = ko'p sayyoh
  'few' — SANALADIGAN otlar bilan.
  Sanalmaydigan bo'lsa: little ↔ a lot of
     little money ≠ a lot of money

items.whyUz:
little ↔ BIG (o'lcham).
Gap: Inishmore is a little island, but Ireland is a big island.

few ↔ A LOT OF (miqdor).
Gap: Fifty years ago there were few tourists, but now there are
a lot of tourists.

quiet ↔ BUSY (gavjumlik).
62-betdagi mashqda ham bor edi.
Gap: Inishmore was a quiet place then, but it is a busy place now.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing prepositions from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: in front of, on, off, back, in, across, at

DIQQAT: 7 ta so'z, 9 ta bo'shliq —
demak ba'zilari IKKI MARTA ishlatiladi:
  'at' → 2 marta (at first, looking at)
  'in' → 2 marta (in fact, in those days)

Hamma iboralar 63-betdagi maqoladan olingan.
Bu — TURG'UN BIRIKMALAR, ular yodlanadi.

items.whyUz:
'ON our page' = sahifamizda.
Gazeta va jurnal sahifasi uchun ON ishlatiladi.

'look AT something' = biror narsaga qaramoq.
DIQQAT: 'look' turli predloglar bilan turli ma'no beradi:
  look AT = qaramoq;  look FOR = qidirmoq;
  look AFTER = qaramoq (parvarish).

'AT first' = dastlab, birinchi qarashda.
DIQQAT: 'at first' ↔ 'at last' (nihoyat).

'IN fact' = aslida, haqiqatda.
'at first' bilan qarama-qarshi qo'yiladi.

'IN those days' = o'sha kunlarda.
O'tgan zamon haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.

'IN FRONT OF his house' = uyi oldida.
Aksi: 'behind' (orqasida).

'BACK then' = o'sha paytda.
'in those days' bilan bir xil ma'noda.

'look ACROSS' = ...bo'ylab qaramoq (bir chetdan ikkinchisiga).
'across' = bo'ylab, kesib o'tib.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the following with the signs.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT BELGI:
  a — CHAPGA egilgan strelka, ostida 'ONLY'
  b — O'NGGA egilgan strelka, ostida 'ONLY'
  c — qizil taxta: chapga qaragan strelka + 'FIRE ESCAPE'
  d — qizil taxta: 'FIRE ESCAPE' + o'ngga qaragan strelka

YANGI SO'Z:
  a fire escape = yong'in chiqish yo'li (zinapoya)
  ONLY = faqat (bu yo'nalishga faqat shu tomonga)

QOIDA:
  BURILISh belgisi (strelka + ONLY) → 'Turn left/right'
  YO'NALISh taxtasi → 'The fire escape is on your left/right'

STRELKA YO'NALISHI:
  chapga → left
  o'ngga → right

pairs.left: 1  The fire escape is on your left.
pairs.whyUz:
Taxtadagi strelka CHAPGA qaragan → 'on your LEFT'.
'on your left' = chap tomoningizda.

Strelka O'NGGA egilgan → 'Turn RIGHT'.
'ONLY' = faqat shu tomonga burilish mumkin.

pairs.left: 3  The fire escape is on your right.
pairs.whyUz: Taxtadagi strelka O'NGGA qaragan → 'on your RIGHT'.

Strelka CHAPGA egilgan → 'Turn LEFT'.
'Turn left/right' — buyruq gap, yo'l ko'rsatishda ishlatiladi.

exercises.explanationUz:
XARITA TUZILISHI (yuqoridan pastga, chapdan o'ngga):

  ┌──────────┬─────────────┬──────────────┬──────────┐
  │ TRAIN    │ SUPERMARKET │ GARAGE       │ HOSPITAL │
  │ STATION  ├─────────────┼──────────────┼──────────┤
  ├──────────┤ SPORTS      │ CINEMA       │ SCHOOL   │
  │ HOTEL    │ CENTRE      ├──────────────┼──────────┤
  ├──────────┼─────────────┤ POLICE       │ PARK     │
  │ MUSEUM   │ DEPARTMENT  │ STATION      │          │
  │          │ STORE       │              │          │
  └──────────┴─────────────┴──────────────┴──────────┘
         ↑ HILL STREET          ↑ APPLE STREET
  ═══════════ KING STREET ═══════════════════════════
           BUS STOP
  ┌────────────┬──────┬──────┬──────┬──────────┐
  │ RESTAURANT │ POST │ CAFÉ │ BANK │ FIRE     │
  │            │OFFICE│      │      │ STATION  │
  └────────────┴──────┴──────┴──────┴──────────┘

UCH KO'CHA:
  HILL STREET  — tik (vertikal), chap tomonda
  APPLE STREET — tik (vertikal), o'ng tomonda
  KING STREET  — yotiq (gorizontal), pastda

JOY PREDLOGLARI:
  next to ..... yonida (yonma-yon, bir tomonda)
  opposite .... ro'parasida (ko'chaning narigi tomonida)
  between ..... orasida (ikkitasining o'rtasida)
  in front of . oldida
  behind ...... orqasida
  on the corner of ... burchagida

points.noteUz:
Yonma-yon, bir tomonda, ko'cha ajratmaydi.
Misol: The police station is next to the cinema.

Ko'chaning NARIGI tomonida, yuzma-yuz.
Misol: The school is opposite the cinema.

Ikkita narsaning O'RTASIDA.
'between A AND B' — 'and' shart.
Misol: The café is between the bank and the post office.

Old tomonida (aksi: behind).
Misol: The bus stop is in front of the post office.

Ikki ko'cha kesishgan joy.
Misol: The park is on the corner of Apple Street and King Street.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the diagram, then complete the sentences with prepositions from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Diagrammaga qarang, so'ng gaplarni ro'yxatdagi predloglar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: in front of, opposite, next to, on, between

Har bir gap uchun xaritada IKKI joyning O'ZARO holatini toping.

items.whyUz:
Maktab va kinoteatr APPLE STREET ning IKKI TOMONIDA →
OPPOSITE (ro'parasida).
Ko'cha ajratsa — 'opposite', ajratmasa — 'next to'.

items.textEn: 2  The café is ............ the bank and the post office.
items.whyUz:
King Street ostidagi qator: RESTAURANT | POST OFFICE | CAFÉ |
BANK | FIRE STATION.
Kafe pochta va bank O'RTASIDA → BETWEEN.
'between A AND B' — 'and' shart.

items.textEn: 3  The police station is ............ the cinema.
items.whyUz:
Kinoteatr va militsiya bo'limi BIR blokda, yonma-yon —
ko'cha ajratmaydi → NEXT TO.
1-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda ko'cha bor edi → opposite.

items.textEn: 4  The bus stop is ............ the post office.
items.hintUz: Bekat King Street ustida, pochta esa ostida
items.whyUz:
Avtobus bekati King Street da, pochtaning OLD tomonida →
IN FRONT OF.

items.textEn: 5  The park is ............ the corner of Apple Street and King Street.
items.whyUz:
'ON the corner of X and Y' = X va Y burchagida —
o'zgarmas ibora.
Bog' Apple Street va King Street kesishgan joyda.

exercises.instructionEn: Where is: the sports centre? the hospital? the bank? the supermarket? the post office? the garage? the police station? the department store? the museum? the restaurant? the fire station? the school?
exercises.instructionUz: Qayerda: sport markazi? kasalxona? bank? supermarket? pochta? garaj? militsiya bo'limi? univermag? muzey? restoran? o't o'chirish bo'limi? maktab?
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOB QOLIPI:
  It's next to / opposite / between ... .

Ko'p joy uchun BIR NECHTA to'g'ri javob bor —
qaysi qo'shni haqida gapirishingizga bog'liq.
Quyida eng aniq javoblar berilgan.

ESLATMA:
  BIR blokda, ko'chasiz → next to
  Ko'cha ajratgan → opposite
  Ikkitasining o'rtasida → between

items.answer: It's between the supermarket and the department store. It's opposite the hotel.
items.whyUz:
Ustunda: SUPERMARKET → SPORTS CENTRE → DEPARTMENT STORE.
Hill Street narigi tomonida HOTEL → opposite.

items.answer: It's next to the school. It's opposite the garage.
items.whyUz:
Kasalxona ustunda maktab ustida → next to.
Apple Street narigi tomonida GARAGE → opposite.

items.answer: It's between the café and the fire station.
items.whyUz:
Qator: RESTAURANT | POST OFFICE | CAFÉ | BANK | FIRE STATION.
Bank kafe va o't o'chirish bo'limi orasida.

items.answer: It's next to the garage. It's opposite the train station.
items.whyUz:
Supermarket va garaj bir qatorda, yonma-yon → next to.
Hill Street narigi tomonida TRAIN STATION → opposite.

items.answer: It's between the restaurant and the café.
items.whyUz:
Pochta restoran va kafe orasida.
Avtobus bekati uning oldida (9a-mashqning 4-bandi).

items.answer: It's next to the supermarket. It's opposite the hospital.
items.whyUz:
Garaj supermarket yonida (ko'chasiz) → next to.
Apple Street narigi tomonida HOSPITAL → opposite.

items.answer: It's next to the cinema and the department store. It's opposite the park.
items.whyUz:
Kinoteatr ostida va univermag yonida → next to.
Apple Street narigi tomonida PARK → opposite.

items.answer: It's next to the police station. It's opposite the museum.
items.whyUz:
Univermag militsiya bo'limi yonida → next to.
Hill Street narigi tomonida MUSEUM → opposite.

items.answer: It's next to the hotel. It's opposite the department store.
items.whyUz:
Muzey mehmonxona ostida → next to.
Hill Street narigi tomonida DEPARTMENT STORE → opposite.

items.answer: It's next to the post office. It's opposite the museum.
items.whyUz:
Restoran pochta yonida → next to.
King Street narigi tomonida MUSEUM → opposite.

items.answer: It's next to the bank. It's opposite the park.
items.whyUz:
O't o'chirish bo'limi bank yonida → next to.
King Street narigi tomonida PARK → opposite.

items.answer: It's between the hospital and the park. It's opposite the cinema.
items.whyUz:
Maktab kasalxona va bog' orasida → between.
Apple Street narigi tomonida CINEMA → opposite (9a-mashqning 1-bandi).

exercises.instructionEn: You are at the train station. Look at the town map in Ex. 9 and fill in the missing words. Listen and check your answers. Then, in pairs, use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Siz temiryo'l bekatidasiz. 9-mashqdagi shahar xaritasiga qarang va tushib qolgan so'zlarni qo'ying. Tinglab, javoblaringizni tekshiring. So'ng juftlikda shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: Excuse me, CAN you tell me the way to the bank?
  B: Yes, of course. Go straight down Hill Street, then take
     the first turning ON YOUR LEFT. Go down King Street.
     The bank is NEXT TO the café.
  A: Thank you very much.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  A: Kechirasiz, bankka qanday borishni aytib bera olasizmi?
  B: Ha, albatta. Hill Street bo'ylab to'g'ri yuring, so'ng
     birinchi burilishdan chapga buriling. King Street bo'ylab
     yuring. Bank kafe yonida.
  A: Katta rahmat.

YO'L KO'RSATISH IBORALARI:
  Can/Could you tell me the way to ...?
     = ...ga qanday borishni aytib bera olasizmi?
  Go straight down/along ... Street
     = ... ko'cha bo'ylab to'g'ri yuring
  Take the first/second turning on your left/right
     = birinchi/ikkinchi burilishdan chapga/o'ngga buriling
  Turn left / Turn right = chapga/o'ngga buriling
  It's on your left/right = u chap/o'ng tomoningizda
  It's next to / opposite / between ...

MARShRUT MANTIG'I (bekatdan bankka):
  Bekat xaritaning yuqori chap burchagida, Hill Street yonida.
  Hill Street bo'ylab PASTGA (janubga) yurasiz.
  Pastda King Street bilan kesishadi — bu BIRINCHI burilish.
  Janubga yurganda SHARQ chap tomonda qoladi.
  Bank sharqda → CHAPGA burilasiz.
  King Street bo'ylab yurib, kafe yonidagi bankka yetasiz.

lines.textEn: Excuse me, 1) ............ you tell me the way to the bank?
lines.whyUz:
'CAN you tell me the way to ...?' — yo'l so'rashning asosiy qolipi.
'COULD you ...?' ham to'g'ri va muloyimroq.
'the way TO + joy' — 'to' shart.

lines.textEn: Yes, of course. Go straight down Hill Street, then take the first turning 2) ............ .
lines.whyUz:
Bekatdan Hill Street bo'ylab PASTGA yurganda
sharq CHAP tomonda qoladi. Bank esa sharqda.
'take the first turning ON YOUR LEFT' = birinchi burilishdan chapga.

lines.textEn: Go down King Street. The bank is 3) ............ the café.
lines.hintUz: Bank va kafe yonma-yonmi yoki ro'paramimi?
lines.whyUz:
King Street ostidagi qatorda: CAFÉ | BANK — yonma-yon,
ko'cha ajratmaydi → NEXT TO.
9a-mashqning 2-bandiga qarang: kafe pochta va bank orasida.

wordFormation.introUz: 64-bet — shahar joylari, joy predloglari va yo'l ko'rsatish.

groups.explanationUz: Ko'pchiligi QO'ShMA ot yoki ot + ot birikmasi.
Ko'cha ajratganmi yoki yo'qmi — asosiy savol.

items.base: Take the first turning on your left
Can you tell me the way to ...?

patterns.formula: The X is NEXT TO / OPPOSITE the Y.
patterns.exampleEn: The police station is next to the cinema. The school is opposite the cinema.
patterns.exampleUz: Militsiya bo'limi kinoteatr yonida. Maktab kinoteatr ro'parasida.
patterns.explanationUz: Ko'cha ajratmasa — NEXT TO;  ajratsa — OPPOSITE.

patterns.formula: The X is BETWEEN the Y AND the Z.
patterns.exampleEn: The café is between the bank and the post office.

patterns.formula: The X is ON THE CORNER OF ... Street AND ... Street.
patterns.exampleEn: The park is on the corner of Apple Street and King Street.
patterns.exampleUz: Bog' Apple Street va King Street burchagida.

patterns.formula: Excuse me, can you tell me the way TO the ...?
patterns.exampleEn: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the bank?
patterns.exampleUz: Kechirasiz, bankka qanday borishni aytib bera olasizmi?
patterns.explanationUz:
Notanish odamdan yo'l so'rashning eng muloyim shakli.
'the way TO' — 'to' shart.

patterns.formula: Go straight down + ko'cha, then take the first turning ON YOUR left/right.
patterns.exampleEn: Go straight down Hill Street, then take the first turning on your left.
patterns.exampleUz: Hill Street bo'ylab to'g'ri yuring, so'ng birinchi burilishdan chapga buriling.
patterns.explanationUz: Yo'l ko'rsatish — BUYRUQ gaplar bilan (ega yo'q).

patterns.exampleEn: a little island ≠ a big island;  few tourists ≠ a lot of tourists
patterns.exampleUz: kichik orol ≠ katta orol;  kam sayyoh ≠ ko'p sayyoh
patterns.explanationUz:
SANALADIGAN: few ↔ a lot of
SANALMAYDIGAN: little ↔ a lot of
